correctness.rationale: The displayed 10 facets give K6 one-skeleton and 10-triangle dual. F₂ Betti vector (1,1,1) follows from connected closed nonorientable surface with χ=6−15+10=1 and F₂ duality. Vertex-edge matching in a 3-critical gradient forms a rooted spanning tree (5 edges); edge-triangle matching forms a rooted dual tree (9 edges); leftover edge is critical. Conversely disjoint primal and dual trees plus root vertex/triangle induce an acyclic Hasse matching; gradient paths cannot alternate dimension across V-path cycles. Independent exhaustive Prüfer generation of all 6^4=1296 spanning trees and separate dual-connectivity test for every one verified complementary unicycles with lengths 5:726, 6:540, 9:30, and 7140 tree-cotree pairs; each critical edge occurs in 476 decompositions; multiplying by six vertex and ten triangle roots gives 428400 fields, 28560 per edge. This is true exhaustive FINITE enumeration for this triangulation, not an infinite proof claim.
residual_risks: Counts only specified six-vertex triangulation; no statement on real-valued Morse functions or coefficient fields other than F₂.
